summary: Backend APIs pass end-to-end (root, photos CRUD, walls CRUD with auto-numbered nome, export with cm→mm conversion and Content-Disposition, 404 on missing). Frontend Home page loads with brand-title and all 4 primary CTAs; CriarParede form loads and repeatable groups add rows. However, saving a wall that includes any ponto (tomada/interruptor/água/esgoto/gás/registro) fails with 422 because the frontend PontoParede factory does not send required 'tipo' field expected by backend PontoParede model. Save without pontos works and navigates to /paredes.
passed: POST /api/photos creates photo; GET /api/photos strips data_base64; GET /api/photos/{id} includes data_base64
POST /api/walls auto-assigns nome 'Parede 01' when no name; accepts custom nome and increments numero
GET /api/walls returns list sorted by numero
DELETE /api/walls/{id} returns 200 for existing and 404 for missing
GET /api/walls/{id}/export returns unit=mm with correct cm×10 conversion (280→2800, 400→4000), includes cores.parede_hex from linked photo, and Content-Disposition attachment header
Home shows brand-title 'TUDO MAIS FÁCIL' and all buttons (btn-foto-parede, btn-foto-piso, btn-criar-parede, btn-paredes-salvas)
/parede/nova renders criar-parede-form with Estrutura open by default; sections toggle; grp-colunas-add / grp-portas-add / grp-tomadas-add add repeatable rows
Save without pontos: POST /api/walls succeeds and navigates to /paredes (walls-grid renders)

failed.issue: Saving a wall containing any ponto (tomadas/interruptores/saidas_agua/saidas_esgoto/saidas_gas/registros_agua) returns HTTP 422. Backend PontoParede model requires 'tipo: str' but frontend factory in CriarParede.jsx (PontosParede.factory, lines 341-346) does not emit a 'tipo' field. Console shows: 'Failed to load resource: 422 at /api/walls'. curl reproduction: POST /api/walls with tomadas=[{distancia_centro:50,lado:'direito',altura_piso:30}] → 422 {loc:['body','tomadas',0,'tipo'], msg:'Field required'}. This blocks the full 24-field wall creation flow required by the MVP.
failed.evidence: curl POST /api/walls with a tomada payload returned 422 with pydantic missing-field error on 'tipo'. Playwright test after clicking grp-tomadas-add and btn-salvar-tudo timed out on navigation to /paredes; console captured 422.

failed.issue: Testids on estrutura inputs use hyphens (input-altura-pe-direito) whereas the review request expected underscores (input_altura_pe_direito). Not a bug per se, but worth noting for future test scripts.
failed.evidence: grep in CriarParede.jsx shows testid="input-altura-pe-direito", testid="input-largura-total", etc.

action_items: Fix ponto payload: either (a) set 'tipo' on each ponto in the frontend factory (e.g., pass tipoKey into PontosParede and include it in factory: tipo: 'tomada' | 'interruptor' | 'agua' | 'esgoto' | 'gas' | 'registro_agua'), or (b) make backend PontoParede.tipo optional with a default (e.g., 'generic') or infer from array key. Frontend fix is preferred so the exported JSON keeps semantic type per ponto.
Re-test full save flow with tomada/interruptor/água/esgoto/gás/registro after fix, then verify export JSON includes those pontos under 'pontos.*' with correct mm values.
Consider aligning field testids to match spec if external test harnesses depend on the underscore version (optional).
